title: LRU cache evicts most-recently-used
description: A fixed-capacity LRU cache should evict the LEAST recently used key when full. The bug marks a key as recently used on get() but pops the wrong end on eviction (it evicts the most recently used), so hot keys disappear.

hidden_tests.test_lru.py:
from lru import LRUCache


def test_lru_evicts_least_recently_used():
    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.put('a', 1)
    c.put('b', 2)
    assert c.get('a') == 1  # 'a' now most recently used
    c.put('c', 3)           # should evict 'b', the LRU
    assert c.get('b') is None
    assert c.get('a') == 1
    assert c.get('c') == 3
